fields.item: Viewer video of a fire at a Lakeshore plant

checks.result: An earlier copy of the video appears in a post dated 2022.
Creation date field stripped by the platform; no result.
Signage in frame does not match the plant; a water tower is not present at the site.
No manifest present. Absence proves nothing.

fields.reasoning: The video predates Tuesday by two years and the location does not match the plant, so it does not show the event it is said to show.
fields.nextStep: Hold the segment. Ask the company and the fire department for comment. Prepare a note on the false video for the 6 PM newscast.
